metadata.protocol: Six midpoint targets on equal-leg length-four spiders with 3..8 legs, followed by the other four root orbits for each shape and eleven tiny permutation controls. One representative per symmetric leg orbit; no root or complement constraint is imposed as symmetry breaking. The prescribed zero is the experiment itself. CP-SAT uses one worker and symmetry_level=0. Preparation counts against each attempt; the total solve loop is bounded, with output finalization afterward. Concurrent execution is permitted for functional evidence; timings are not performance comparisons.
